optimizedContext.value:
# Graph Search

## Rules

- Signature: `specd graph search <query> [--symbols] [--files] [--specs] [--documents] [--snippet] [--kind <kinds>] [--file <path>] [--workspace <name>] [--exclude-path <pattern>] [--exclude-workspace <name>] [--limit <n>] [--spec-content] [--config <path> | --path <path>] [--format text|json|toon]`.
- Query required; default limit `10`. Category flags pick target categories (all if none). `--config`/`--path` mutually exclusive.
- Delegate search to Code Graph search use case; CLI performs no query-plan, ranking, snippet, or candidate-merging logic.
- Shared query plan ranks: (1) contiguous complete-query, (2) all raw terms, (3) raw term, (4) expanded component. Semantic tiers: exact logical ID, exact public binding, exact declaration (matching/norm case), prefix/component, exact local symbol, textual relevance. Structured results expose `matchTier` & `matchReasons`.
- Occurrence suppression & capping: symbol selection range suppresses duplicate source file matches. Wildcard/general file search caps at 10 matches per file (`full-query` > `raw-term` > `expanded-term`). Exact single-file returns all matches in source order. Exposes `totalMatches`, `matches`, `omittedMatches`.
- Output format: grouped by `symbols`, `files`, `specs`, `documents`. Text shows match export info (`matched export: <path>::<name>`). Text renders `N more matches in this file`. `--snippet` includes match-centered preview blocks. Empty output: `No results found.`
- Provider errors (`GRAPH_BUSY`, `GRAPH_PROVIDER_STALE`, open failure) exit 3.

## Constraints

- CLI contains no search, ranking, or snippet logic.
- Store filters (`--kind`, `--file`, `--workspace`, `--exclude-*`) applied before limits.
- Provider availability owned by provider after open.
- Call `process.exit(0)` after provider closes.
